properties.key: Stable identity used to preserve state across rebuilds.
properties.data: Arbitrary value you can attach to the control and read back in handlers.
properties.label: Text label shown for the control.
properties.content: The single child control rendered inside this control.
properties.title: The control shown as the title.
properties.subtitle: The control shown as the secondary line below the title.
properties.leading: Control placed before the main content (e.g. an icon or avatar).
properties.trailing: Control placed after the main content.
properties.actions: Controls shown in the trailing action area.
properties.icon: Icon name shown by the control.
properties.src: Source URL or asset path of the image.
properties.url: URL the control loads or links to.
properties.options: The selectable options (built with the control's option helper).
properties.divisions: Number of discrete steps between min and max.
properties.hint_text: Placeholder shown when the field is empty.
properties.helper_text: Helper text shown below the field.
properties.error_text: Error message shown below the field; also marks it invalid.
properties.password: Obscures the entered text when true.
properties.multiline: Allows multiple lines of input when true.
properties.read_only: Prevents editing while still allowing selection.
properties.clip_behavior: How content overflowing the bounds is clipped.
properties.expand: Fills the available space along the parent's main axis when true.
properties.expand_loose: Like expand, but only grows up to the child's natural size.
properties.padding: Inner spacing between the border and the content.
properties.align: Alignment of the control within its parent.
properties.alignment: Alignment of the content within the control.
properties.top: Top offset when positioned inside a stack.
properties.bottom: Bottom offset when positioned inside a stack.
properties.left: Left offset when positioned inside a stack.
properties.right: Right offset when positioned inside a stack.
properties.scale: Scale transform applied to the control.
properties.offset: Translation offset applied to the control.
properties.adaptive: Adapts to the platform (Material/Cupertino) when true.
properties.badge: Badge drawn on the corner of the control.
properties.mouse_cursor: Cursor shown when hovering the control.
properties.size_change_interval: Throttle interval for on_size_change, in ms.

events.on_click: Fired when the control is clicked/tapped.
events.on_change_start: Fired when the user starts changing the value.
events.on_change_end: Fired when the user finishes changing the value.
events.on_submit: Fired when the input is submitted.
events.on_focus: Fired when the control gains focus.
events.on_blur: Fired when the control loses focus.
events.on_hover: Fired when the pointer enters/leaves the control.
events.on_tap_down: Fired when a pointer presses down.
events.on_tap_cancel: Fired when a tap is cancelled.
events.on_tap_outside: Fired when a tap occurs outside the control.
events.on_dismiss: Fired when the control is dismissed.
events.on_scroll: Fired when the scroll position changes.
events.on_select: Fired when a selection is made.
events.on_selection_change: Fired when the selection range changes.
events.on_state_change: Fired when the control's state changes.
events.on_enter: Fired when the pointer enters the control.
events.on_exit: Fired when the pointer leaves the control.
events.on_image_error: Fired when the image fails to load.
events.on_loaded: Fired when the control has loaded.
events.on_visible: Fired when the control becomes visible.
events.on_resize: Fired when the control is resized.
events.on_size_change: Fired when the control's size changes.
